name: metr_point_v0_noise_input_090
rationale: The scalar in_proj weight is the entry of the noisy-state branch, while conditioning values and their observation mask enter a separate CFEM projection. The 100-draw median still has a calibration error pattern with heavy opposite tails in congested and free-flow predictions. Reduce only the noisy scalar's 64 input weights by 10%, retaining every bias and the complete conditioning branch, to test whether excessive stochastic-state influence contributes to that error. This is an explicit structural hypothesis, not an assumed improvement or a change of the evaluation noise schedule.
